query: My TechCorp X1 Ultra screen flashes extremely quickly (in milliseconds) whenever I plug in a charger, making the display unusable for a short period.

contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Blank Display Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Blank display fix

actions.actionName: Check for Physical Damage and Liquid Exposure
actions.description: It will rule out hardware damage

steps: Carefully inspect your phone or tablet, charger, and USB cable for any physical damage or signs of liquid exposure.
Remove any cases or accessories that might be covering the charging port or buttons.
Examine the USB connections for any corrosion or bent pins.
Turn off your phone or tablet.
Insert the ejector tool into the small hole next to the SIM/MicroSD tray to eject the tray.
Shine a flashlight into the SIM/MicroSD slot.
Connect your phone or tablet to its appropriate charger.
Let it charge for at least 1 hour.

actions.description: It will attempt to power on

steps: After charging, disconnect the phone or tablet from the charger.
Try to turn it on by pressing and holding the Power button (or Side button) for 15 to 20 seconds.
Reconnect it to the appropriate charger until it is fully charged.
Contact the Customer Support Center for further assistance.

actions.description: It will force the phone to restart

steps: Press and hold both the Power button (or Side button) and the Volume down button simultaneously for at least 20 seconds.
If your device has a removable battery, remove the battery for 60 seconds.
